messages:
Ivy (infra): Heads up: scheduling a rolling soft-reboot for the 'gale' GPU cohort in us-west2 — Tue 01:30-03:00 UTC. NIC microcode + BIOS thermal trim. No power cycles.
Sam (sre): Copy. Expected impact?
Ivy (infra): ~8% capacity reduction at peak. We'll drain node -> soft-reboot -> health-check -> uncordon. Parallelism=3, cadence ~1 node / 90s.
Noel (oncall): Can we seed warm spares? Need to avoid cold KV misses.
Rae (scheduler): Reserving 6 warm GPUs in same AZ (gale-warm). Seeding runs 60m before window: `ops/seed_cache --pool=gale-warm --prefix=top50 --concurrency=3`.
Maya (support): Draft notice for pinned customers: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 may cause transient latency and minor throttling 01:30-03:00 UTC. No data loss expected." Will post after approvals.
Sam (sre): Canary: 1 node, 5% traffic for 10m. Health gates: p95 < baseline+30ms, error-rate <0.6%. If breach -> stop rollout and rollback NIC image.
Ivy (infra): Routing hint: avoid nodes with uptime <5m (`route_avoid_recent_boot=true`). Also set fallbacks to eu-west for latency-sensitive tenants.
Noel (oncall): Paging rule: if free GPUs <5 for >5m page oncall. Also watch KV miss >8% for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: "gale maintenance in 24h" posted to #eng-infra and #oncall.
Rae (scheduler): Timeline: 00:30 seed, 01:20 smoke test, 01:30 canary, 01:45 evaluate, 01:50 roll with parallelism=3, finish ~02:50, cooldown to 03:00.
Maya (support): Cost estimate ~900 USD for warmbackfill + IO. Finance ok.
Ivy (infra): React :thumbsup: to acknowledge, I'll flip reminders to 2h and 15m.
Noel (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll be on standby.
Sam (sre): :thumbsup: prepping dashboards and rollback script.
Rae (scheduler): :thumbsup: job queued `gale-soft-restart-v2` (dry-run passed).
Ivy (infra): Thanks team. Anything else?
Noel (oncall): Nothing else. :coffee:
